mapper.sql: select p.id, p.name, p.owner_key, p.note, p.create_time, p.update_time, (select count(*) from media_playlist_item i where i.playlist_id = p.id) as item_count from media_playlist p
mapper.select: order by p.owner_key is not null, p.owner_key asc, p.update_time desc, p.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into media_playlist (name, owner_key, note, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{ownerKey}, #{note}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp)
mapper.update: update media_playlist set update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
